pieces.name: TL_RoofTiles_Middle
pieces.note: Plain panel between the ends, any row. Not manifold (open edges show gaps): not used.

pieces.name: TL_RoofTiles_MiddleSide
pieces.note: Eave/middle row panel with its verge at its +X end; mirrored for the other end.

pieces.name: TL_RoofTiles_MiddleSide_Half

pieces.name: TL_RoofTiles_TopCorner

pieces.name: TL_RoofTiles_TopCorner_Half

pieces.name: TL_Roof_PeakedBase
pieces.note: Lowest third of a quarter spire, its eave corner at +X+Z. eave: the outer bottom corner; next: where the middle's pivot goes (from the pack's tower).

pieces.name: TL_Roof_PeakedMiddle
pieces.note: Middle third of a quarter spire, its outer corner at +X+Z. next: where the top's pivot goes (from the pack's tower).

pieces.name: TL_Roof_PeakedTop
pieces.note: Cap of a quarter spire, its outer corner at -X+Z (a quarter turn from the base and middle). tip: the spire's point.

The lamp post faces +Z.
